1) word embedding models have a high uncertainty factor regarding to the similarity values; 2) the uncertainty factor can be quantified by the standard deviation of the similarity scores of a term with its top-k similar terms; 3) a threshold can be introduced on the uncertainty factor which effectively filters the terms that are highly related; 4) the proposed threshold is applicable to different dimensions of word embeddings and can be used to improve the quality of word embedding-based tasks such as document clustering.
